scope: read-only source/product inspection; no product changes

findings.finding: Accepted TXID rendered as first 20 characters; no full-ID receipt or copy control.
History TXID shortened to 18+8 characters; rows have no detail/copy action.
History is collapsed below wallet addresses, outside the primary active-wallet actions.
Every status other than confirmed is rendered Pending; non-array transactions render as empty.
Transaction-endpoint rejection has an error message, but status-endpoint rejection exits before history state updates.
Scans latest 100 network transactions ordered by mempool_seq, filters active address, returns at most 30; no pagination/coverage metadata.
History is fetched per active address, not stored with recovery material; derived wallet has five addresses, legacy may have one. Reload/recovery can restore only source-available history.
A successful submit is followed by awaited refresh; refresh failure reaches the same handler that replaces sendstate with an error.
created_at is a PostgreSQL timestamptz/ISO string; Number(timestamp) yields NaN and the current helper suppresses the date.
Transfer-table history excludes mining rewards; do not invent reward TXIDs or inherit Explorer coverage.
Clipboard API with execCommand fallback exists; keep existing receive/seed behavior unchanged while adding TXID-specific feedback.
Current code rejects cross-address responses when wallet.address differs; this helps but does not alone resolve A→B→A or in-flight refresh deduplication.

source_vs_runtime: Three public frontend assets have been fetched and matched; backend behavior is inspected from pinned source, not claimed runtime-matched.
